sources.title: ちょべりば作業の会！三人のグループ名欲しいな～～！！！！ #Minecraft【#一条莉々華/hololive DEV_IS】
sources.owner: Ririka Ch. 一条莉々華 ‐ ReGLOSS
sources.evidence: Official custom description identifies Ao and Hajime as collaborators, uploader is Ririka. Original automatic transcript2:42:40–2:43:29 derives name from 姉御肌 and says this applies to all three.2:45:48–2:46:42 discusses 姉/あねご in hiragana plus 組 in kanji, rejects gummy spelling because it makes Hajime the gummy, and finalizes the group name with cheer. ASR repeatedly drops ね from あねご and renders あご; normalized あねご組 reading is context-based and matches discovery spelling. No performer-added on-screen written heading or independently accurate audio transcription established.

Japanese automatic transcript39:01–39:06 explicitly frames name selection for Ao/Kanade/Ririka.46:19–47:23 settles name and discusses hiragana versus katakana choice; ASR mangles spoken name as 音花火 / お花.51:07–51:31 corrects Ao-hibana to oto-hibana.
